# make the scatterplots
```{r}
all2 = all %>%
  filter(!is.na(Category)) %>%
  mutate(BrandZ = if_else(is.na(Salient), "Not in BrandZ", "In BrandZ")) 
all2 %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = logAdSpend, y = BRP5)) +
  # BrandZ brands: circles sized by Salience
  geom_point(data = ~ filter(.x, !is.na(Salient)),
    aes(size = Salient), shape = 16, alpha = 0.8) +
  # Brands not in BrandZ: fixed-size X
  geom_point(data = ~ filter(.x, is.na(Salient)),
    shape = 4, size = 3) +
  geom_text_repel(aes(label = BrandShort),
    cex = 1.7, show.legend = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~ Category) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(2, 7)) +
  labs(x = "log(Ad Spend)", y = "BRP@5", size = "BrandZ Salience") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "top")

all2 %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = logAdSpend, y = MRR)) +
  # BrandZ brands: circles sized by Salience
  geom_point(data = ~ filter(.x, !is.na(Salient)),
    aes(size = Salient), shape = 16, alpha = 0.8) +
  # Brands not in BrandZ: fixed-size X
  geom_point(data = ~ filter(.x, is.na(Salient)),
    shape = 4, size = 3) +
  geom_text_repel(aes(label = BrandShort),
    cex = 1.7, show.legend = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~ Category) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(2, 7)) +
  labs(x = "log(Ad Spend)", y = "MRR", size = "Salience") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "top")
```

# fraction logit with ridge model
```{r}
library(glmnet)
all2 <- all %>%
  filter(complete.cases(logSearch, logAdSpend,
    logNews,logBrandwatch, MRR, logWiki, Category)) %>%
  mutate(across(
    c(logAdSpend, logSearch, logBrandwatch, logNews, logWiki),
    ~ as.numeric(scale(.x))
  ))
x <- model.matrix(
  ~ Category+logAdSpend+logNews+logSearch+logBrandwatch+logWiki,  
  data = all2)[, -1]
y <- all2$MRR
cat("dim of x matrix: ")
dim(x)

ridge <- glmnet(x, y, quasibinomial(link="logit"),  alpha=0)
ridge$beta[,ncol(ridge$beta)]
plot(ridge, xvar = "lambda", label = TRUE)
# 1=catfood, 2=coffee, 3=drill, 4=hike, 5=ad, 6=news, 
# 7=google, 8=brand, 9=wiki
abline(h=0)
set.seed(54321)
cv.ridge <- cv.glmnet(x, y, family = quasibinomial(link="logit"), alpha=0)
log(c(cv.ridge$lambda.min, cv.ridge$lambda.1se))
coef(cv.ridge, s = "lambda.min")
# Google, brandwatch and news tied, wiki and adspend tied
```

# make better plot for article
```{r}
B <- as.matrix(ridge$beta)
Bplot <- B[-(1:4), ] # Remove the first four category coefficients
matplot(log(ridge$lambda), t(Bplot), type = "l", lty = 1, 
    xlab = "log(lambda)", ylab = "Coefficient (predictors standardized)"
)
abline(h = 0, lty = 2)
legend("topright",
  legend = rownames(Bplot),
  lty = 1, col = seq_len(nrow(Bplot)), cex = .8
)
abline(v=log(cv.ridge$lambda.min))
abline(v=log(cv.ridge$lambda.1se), col=2)
```

# Robuestness check: Lasso
```{r}
lasso <- glmnet(x, y, quasibinomial(link="logit"),  alpha=1)
set.seed(54321)
cv.lasso <- cv.glmnet(x, y, family=quasibinomial(link="logit"), alpha=1)
B <- as.matrix(lasso$beta)
Bplot <- B[-(1:4), ] # Remove the first four category coefficients
matplot(log(lasso$lambda), t(Bplot), type = "l", lty = 1, 
    xlab = "log(lambda)", ylab = "Coefficient (predictors standardized)")
abline(h = 0, lty = 2)
legend("topright", legend = rownames(Bplot),
  lty = 1, col = seq_len(nrow(Bplot)), cex = .8)
abline(v=log(cv.lasso$lambda.min))
abline(v=log(cv.lasso$lambda.1se), col=2)
```



# Robustness checks: OLS
```{r}
fit.ols = lm(MRR ~ Category+logAdSpend+logWiki+logNews+logSearch+logBrandwatch, data=all)
summary(fit.ols) # Google**, brandwatch*, ad and news and wiki NS
# now log MRR as variance stabilizing transformation
fitolssqrt = lm(sqrt(MRR) ~ Category+logAdSpend+logWiki+logNews+logSearch+logBrandwatch, data=all)
summary(fitolssqrt) # Google***, brandwatch**, ad-*, news and wiki NS
```
OLS: Search is most important, brandwatch second, others NS. When we add a variance stabilizing transform the story is the same, but adspend becomes borderline sig with a signflip.
